sun.text: Replace the grid of planets with the orrery's sun: the root entity alone, at the origin, 1.5 times the model's size – and it no longer turns.
sun.hint: The two nested loops go, and so does the root's `setLocalRotation` in the render loop (the `updateSelfAndChild` stays). `setLocalScale` on the root.

planets.text: Hang three planets on the sun as its children, lined up on its x axis in the sun's units: Pip at 2.4 (scale 0.2), Bramble at 4 (0.35) and Old Gourd at 6 (0.4).
planets.hint: `addChild` on the root, then `setLocalPosition` and `setLocalScale` on `children.back()` – three times, or in a loop over two small arrays.

orbits.text: Let every planet circle the sun counter-clockwise seen from above, starting from the x axis: Pip at 80, Bramble at 40 and Old Gourd at 20 degrees per second.
orbits.hint: Every frame before the graph is updated: `angle = radians(speed × time)` and `setLocalPosition(children[i].transform, (r · cos(angle), 0, −r · sin(angle)))` with the planet's distance `r` in sun units.

moon.text: Give Bramble a moon: a child of Bramble at 2.5 Bramble units with the scale 0.35; Bramble turns about its own axis at 120 degrees per second and carries the moon round.
moon.hint: `addChild(children[1], …)` once all three planets are added; in the loop `setLocalRotation` on Bramble with `120 × time` degrees about y.

counter.text: Show in the window title how many of the orrery's bodies are drawn and how many the frustum culled.

hint.opengl: The culled bodies are `total - display`; build the title with `std::to_string` as before.
hint.vulkan: The culled bodies are `total - display`; build the title with `std::to_string` as before.
hint.d3d12: The culled bodies are `total - display`; build the title with `std::to_wstring` as before.
